instruction_compliance.credential_hygiene: Report references environment variable NAMES only (for example TELNYX_API_KEY, TELNYX_CALL_CONTROL_API_HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUGSNAG_API_KEY). No secret values, no .env file contents, and no model or CI credentials appear in this document.

source_architecture.framework: Next.js 12.1.0 pages-router application built with React 17.0.1 and TypeScript in strict mode; one deployment serves both the browser SPA and the HTTP API.
source_architecture.rendering_stack: Grommet component library, styled-components for screen-scoped CSS, @fortawesome/react-fontawesome icons, react-hot-toast notifications, react-draggable/react-resize-detector behaviors.
source_architecture.toolchain: yarn classic lockfile, eslint (eslint-config-next), no unit/component/server-route/browser test scripts exist in package.json; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) only runs install, lint, and build on the declared Node range (>=22.23.4 <23).

server_layout.route_pattern: Each Telnyx upstream operation is a thin Next.js API route under pages/api; routes read secrets only from process.env, propagate a uuid request_id header, report failures through lib/bugsnag.js notify() and utils/helpers.ts transformFetchErrorToBugsnag(), and map upstream status/JSON onto the response.

endpoints.client_exposes: room list rows only; no credentials
join token and refresh token (token_ttl_secs 60, refresh_token_ttl_secs 3600)

endpoints.upstream_call: POST refresh to ${TELNYX_API_HOST} rooms action with token_ttl_secs 120; NOTE the route reads req.body.room_id for the URL but the browser (hooks/room.ts) only posts refresh_token, a source quirk the Vue layer must preserve until a regression test proves the intended behavior

contexts.name: TelnyxMeetContext
contexts.role: Application-wide meeting state: audio/video device IDs and setters, isAudioTrackEnabled/isVideoTrackEnabled and setters, sendNotification (react-hot-toast wrapper in pages/rooms/index.tsx), networkMetrics and setter, unreadMessages ref, isVideoPlaying and setter, optionalFeatures flags derived from query parameters.

contexts.name: DebugContext
contexts.role: Loose debug state pair ([state, setState]) carried from hooks/room.ts into pages/_app.tsx; Vue equivalent is a small store slice or composable, not a React context.

local_state_owners.state: roomId, username, tokens, isReady, device IDs, isAudioTrackEnabled/isVideoTrackEnabled, networkMetrics, isVideoPlaying, error, reconnectCount, optionalFeatures (from router query).
Telnyx SDK Room ref, state, clientToken, presenter, participantsByActivity, dominantSpeakerId (with a 5s reset timer and 5s window), messages, plus token refresh interval at TOKEN_TTL-20 seconds.

app_state_model.persistence: utils/storage.ts wraps localStorage/sessionStorage; keys used: username, audioEnabled, videoEnabled, background_type.

video_sdk_boundary.current_surface: @telnyx/video 1.0.1 is imported from three application locations: hooks/room.ts (initialize, Room lifecycle and subscriptions), components/RoomControls/RoomControls.tsx (getDevices, Room/Participant/Stream types for controls), components/MediaPreview/index.tsx (videoDiagnostics). @telnyx/video-processors (VideoProcessor/Camera) is used by utils/virtualBackground.ts; @telnyx/rtc-diagnostics is used in components/MediaPreview/index.tsx.
video_sdk_boundary.isolation_assessment: No adapter or fake exists; the Room ref and its 18 listeners are owned inside the useRoom hook and were never off()-subscribed, never disconnect()-ed on unmount, and the dominant-speaker timer plus token refresh interval are cleared only partially.

candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_to: Nuxt 3 app.vue + app.config.ts + server plugin; Bugsnag React error boundary (lib/bugsnag.js, pages/_app.tsx) re-expressed as a Nuxt error handler + Vue errorCaptured; PWA metadata preserved from public/manifest.json, public/icon-192x192.png, public/icon-512x512.png, public/*.webp.

candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_from: pages/index.tsx, pages/rooms/index.tsx, pages/rooms/list.tsx, pages/rooms/[roomId].tsx, pages/404.tsx, pages/_error.tsx
candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_to: Nuxt file routing under pages/ (index.vue, rooms/index.vue, rooms/list.vue, rooms/[roomId].vue, error.vue) preserving direct-room-URL query support (client_token, refresh_token) and optional feature flags (audio_control, dial_out, network_metrics, simulcast, diagnostics, auto_reconnect) read from useRoute().query in pages/rooms/index.tsx.

Nuxt 3 Nitro server routes under server/api (rooms/index.ts, rooms/[roomId].ts, client_token.ts, refresh_client_token.ts, dial_out.ts) with H3 helpers replacing NextApiRequest/NextApiResponse; secrets read via runtimeConfig/process.env exclusively.

candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_from: contexts/TelnyxMeetContext.ts, contexts/DebugContext.ts, local useState in pages/rooms/index.tsx
candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_to: Pinia stores under stores/ (meet store for device/audio/video flags, network metrics, unread messages, optional features; debug store for the DebugContext pair); sendNotification backed by a Vue toast primitive replacing react-hot-toast.

candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_from: hooks/room.ts, components/RoomControls/RoomControls.tsx SDK usage, components/MediaPreview/index.tsx diagnostics usage
candidate_nuxt_seams.maps_to: A typed composable useTelnyxRoom() under composables/ owning initialization, a single listener registration site for all 18 events, token refresh cadence, network-metrics flags, and a guaranteed dispose() that removes listeners, clears timers, disconnects the Room, and frees generated media; @telnyx/video consumers become imports of this composable only.

Vue 3 SFCs with Composition API; media preview (components/MediaPreview/index.tsx, MediaControlBar.tsx) becomes a preview composable plus component; grid/presentation layout (components/GridLayout.tsx, ScreenSharingLayout.tsx, Feed/Feed.tsx, Feeds.tsx), chat, participants, invite, WebRTC stats and network metrics views become Vue components consuming the composable state instead of the SDK directly.

Composition-layer composable(s) for getUserMedia constraint building (getMediaConstraints/getUserMedia in utils/userMedia.ts), device enumeration, mixed audio (components/RoomAudio.tsx), and virtual-background VideoProcessor/Camera lifecycle from utils/virtualBackground.ts with deterministic track/VideoProcessor stop.

lifecycle_gaps_to_close.gap: No off()/disconnect() for the 18 SDK listeners owned in hooks/room.ts; listener removal, interval clearing (token refresh, dominant-speaker timeout), and track/VideoProcessor stops must be centralized in the Vue composable teardown.

Direct SDK method calls from UI layers (components/RoomControls/RoomControls.tsx calls addStream/removeStream/updateStream/disconnect; pages/rooms/index.tsx fetches /api/refresh_client_token directly) bypass any single ownership boundary; the Vue boundary must funnel every SDK and token operation through the composable store.

work_packages.title: Stand up Nuxt 3/Vue 3/TypeScript shell and clean-build toolchain
work_packages.objective: Replace the Next.js shell (pages/_app.tsx, pages/_document.tsx, next.config.js, package.json) with a Nuxt 3 app: nuxt.config.ts, app.vue, strict tsconfig, eslint + prettier config derived from the existing .eslintrc.json/.prettierrc, Vitest/Vue Test Utils/Playwright setup, and CI scripts for install/build/typecheck/lint/unit/component/server-route/smoke. Preserve declared Node >=22.23.4 <23, public/ PWA assets, and styles/globals.css.
test_plan: Clean checkout installs from the committed lockfile (yarn install --frozen-lockfile).
yarn build, yarn typecheck, yarn lint exit 0 with zero diagnostics.
Smoke: root route renders AppHeader and demo note against mocked server responses.
work_packages.done_when: Repository builds, type-checks, and lints from a clean install on the declared Node range with no Next.js/React runtime left in production dependencies.

work_packages.title: Port landing, room list, and room-lookup pages to Nuxt routes
work_packages.objective: Migrate pages/index.tsx, pages/rooms/list.tsx, and the rooms table/list UI to Vue SFC pages under pages/ (plus error.vue and 404 handling) with data-testid hooks preserved (btn-select-room), fetching /api/rooms client-side, and usable desktop and narrow-viewport layouts replacing Grommet DataTable/Box/Text markup.
test_plan: Component tests: room table renders from mocked /api/rooms payload, presents unique_name, id link to /rooms/[id], max participants, record audio/video.
Component tests: empty-room state shows the 'No rooms found' notice; loading state shown before the fetch resolves.
Browser smoke: landing page link navigates to the rooms page.
work_packages.done_when: Landing and room list pages render in Nuxt with tested success, empty, and loading states and no React/Grommet imports.

work_packages.title: Rebuild the five Telnyx server routes as Nuxt server routes with validation and error mapping
work_packages.objective: Implement server/api routes for room list (GET), room lookup (GET by id), join client token (POST), refresh client token (POST), and dial-out (POST) mirroring pages/api/** semantics: uuid request_id propagation, method guards returning 405 with Allow headers, body field validation, upstream status/JSON mapping, and error reporting through the ported bugsnag helper. Keep TELNYX_API_KEY, TELNYX_API_HOST, and TELNYX_CALL_CONTROL_API_HOST strictly server-side via process.env/runtimeConfig.
test_plan: Server-route tests with a mocked upstream: success, 4xx, 5xx, missing body fields, and wrong-method (405 + Allow) for every one of the five routes.
Secret-scan test: asserted that Bearer credentials are taken only from server process.env and no route references credential string literals.
Mapping test: upstream error body message surfaces verbatim in the response, matching pages/api behavior.
work_packages.done_when: All five server routes pass success/failure/validation tests and the static scan proves browser code and emitted payloads carry no Telnyx credentials.

work_packages.title: Create the typed useTelnyxRoom composable covering full SDK lifecycle, alongside deterministic test doubles
work_packages.objective: Extract hooks/room.ts into composables/useTelnyxRoom.ts: initialization via initialize() (roomId, clientToken, context, enableMessages), connected-state subscription management (addSubscription for remote streams), presenter tracking from stream key 'presentation', active speaker and participantsByActivity computation, message recording, network-metrics report toggling, token refresh cadence (TOKEN_TTL minus 20s) calling /api/refresh_client_token, and a dispose() that removes every one of the 18 listeners, clears both timers, and disconnects the Room. Expose a typed TelnyxRoom model. Deliver together a deterministic fake of @telnyx/video (tests/fakes/telnyx-video.ts) with scriptable emission of the 18-event surface and listener add/off/inspect helpers, plus a media test double (tests/fakes/media.ts) covering getUserMedia, MediaStreamTrack stop, enumerateDevices, and a fake VideoProcessor/Camera for virtual-background tests; all doubles stay under tests/ and never enter production code paths.
test_plan: Unit tests against the SDK fake: initialize, connect, and each of the 18 events update the exposed reactive state exactly once.
Listener accounting test: dispose() removes all registered handlers (fake listener count returns to 0) and clearInterval/clearTimeout spies report zero live timers.
Token refresh test with fake timers: refresh fires at the configured cadence only while state.status is connected.
Reconnect test: a disconnected(reason, state) network_error path surfaces the onDisconnected callback for the page-layer retry logic.
Fake contract test: the fake emits every event in the 18-event surface and subscribers receive the documented payload shape.
Double hygiene test: media fakes stop() deterministically and appear in no production import graph (only under tests/).
work_packages.done_when: The composable is covered by deterministic fake-driven unit tests proving typed events, subscription behavior, and cleanup, with no raw @telnyx/video listener registration outside the composable, and the fake + media doubles are importable by every test suite without live credentials.

work_packages.title: Migrate application state from React contexts to a Pinia meet store
work_packages.objective: Replace contexts/TelnyxMeetContext.ts and contexts/DebugContext.ts with a Pinia store (stores/meet.ts) carrying audio/video device IDs and setters, isAudioTrackEnabled/isVideoTrackEnabled, isVideoPlaying, networkMetrics, unread messages, optional feature flags parsed from route query (audio_control, dial_out, network_metrics, simulcast, diagnostics, auto_reconnect as in pages/rooms/index.tsx), and a sendNotification action backed by a Vue toast replacing react-hot-toast.
test_plan: Store unit tests: each state slice mutates reactively and the optional-features parser maps 'true' query strings exactly as the source does.
Action tests: sendNotification queues toasts; unread messages accumulate in arrival order.
Persistence test: username and device preferences round-trip through the localStorage helpers in utils/storage.ts.
work_packages.done_when: No React context modules remain, all durable meeting state lives in the store, and store unit tests prove flags, notifications, and unread messages behave as the source did.

work_packages.title: Port the room join page, token flow, and auto-reconnect logic
work_packages.objective: Migrate pages/rooms/index.tsx and components/JoinRoom.tsx to pages/rooms/index.vue (plus a direct-room route at pages/rooms/[roomId].vue ported from pages/rooms/[roomId].tsx): room UUID + username form, supplied client/refresh token query support, /api/client_token fetch on join, audio permission check with ErrorDialog on denial, and auto_reconnect handling (up to MAX_RECONNECT_TIME) wired to the useTelnyxRoom onDisconnected callback.
test_plan: Component tests: join fetches /api/client_token only when query tokens are absent; join button disabled without roomId/username.
Component tests: NotAllowedError from the audio permission probe opens the mediaBlocked ErrorDialog path.
Component tests: with auto_reconnect=true, three network_error disconnections rejoin and the fourth gives up (MAX_RECONNECT_TIME=3).
Component tests: direct room URL with client_token and refresh_token bypasses the token API.
work_packages.done_when: Join, direct-URL, permission-denial, error, and auto-reconnect flows pass component tests with mocked HTTP and media boundaries.

work_packages.title: Port media preview, device selection, and diagnostics into a Vue preview system
work_packages.objective: Migrate components/MediaPreview/index.tsx, MediaControlBar.tsx, helper.tsx, and utils/userMedia.ts into a Vue preview composable (composables/useMediaPreview.ts) plus components/media-preview.vue and components/media-control-bar.vue: getUserMedia constraint building (simulcast-aware), camera/microphone toggles, input/output device menus, diagnostics launch via @telnyx/rtc-diagnostics, and media-error handling, with deterministic track start/stop.
test_plan: Component tests: preview renders local tracks from the fake MediaStream; toggling camera/mic changes enabled state in the meet store.
Component tests: switching audio/video input devices re-acquires media with the constraint deviceId; simulcast flag adds 1280x720 video constraints.
Cleanup test: unmount stops every fake MediaStreamTrack exactly once (no leaked tracks).
Error test: MediaDeviceErrors mapping (mediaBlocked, mediaUnknown) surfaces through the ErrorDialog path.
work_packages.done_when: Pre-join preview supports toggles, device selection, simulcast constraints, and diagnostics launch with all media resources released on unmount in tests.

Route panel widths for narrow viewports.

Component tests: device menu lists enumerate fake devices; selecting one re-acquires media with the deviceId.
Component tests: screen share adds a 'presentation' stream to the fake room; the presenter id is exposed for the layout.

Narrow-viewport test: control bar reflows without horizontal scroll at the small breakpoint.

work_packages.title: Compose browser smoke suites, credential hygiene, and migration documentation
work_packages.objective: Add Playwright browser-smoke flows against a mocked upstream (landing, room list, join pre-join, connected meeting with fake participants, presentation, chat, error and 404 states) plus desktop and narrow-viewport screenshot captures; add CI credential-hygiene scan (no tracked secret-bearing files, no emitted secrets in logs); and document architecture, behavior parity matrix, environment and security notes, clean build instructions, test instructions, and migration decisions in docs/.
test_plan: Playwright smoke: each flow above passes headless with no live Telnyx credentials, using the mocked upstream and SDK fake.
Screenshot suite: captures desktop and narrow-viewport states for landing, pre-join, connected meeting, participant panel, chat, presentation, and error states into a reviewable artifacts directory.
Hygiene scan: asserts .env files and credentials are git-ignored and no tracked file contains secret-bearing content.
Doc completeness check: every required doc file exists and links to source paths and test files.
work_packages.done_when: Browser smoke and screenshot suites pass in CI, the hygiene scan is clean, and the five documentation pages satisfy the documentation gate.

work_packages_note: Exactly twelve independently testable work packages. The deterministic @telnyx/video fake and media test doubles are delivered as part of wp-sdk-adapter so that the consumer of the boundary (the 18-listener surface of hooks/room.ts) is verified in the same package, keeping the graph small and dependency-free at that boundary rather than forcing an extra package layer.
